PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.S1_BODY: Erwaa Higher Institute for Training is committed to protecting the privacy of its trainees, corporate clients, and partners. This policy describes the data we collect, how we use it, and our commitment to keeping it safe.
PRIVACY.S2_BODY: We collect personal information you provide during registration such as name, phone number, email, and educational qualification, as well as usage data including IP addresses and session logs.
PRIVACY.S3_BODY: We use your data to enroll you in the requested programs and courses, track your training progress, issue certificates, and contact you regarding schedules and updates.
PRIVACY.S4_BODY: We do not sell your data to third parties. We may share it with the trainers assigned to your program, relevant official bodies (such as the Technical and Vocational Training Corporation) where legally required, or technical service providers needed to run the platform.
PRIVACY.S5_BODY: We apply advanced encryption standards and strict security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access or disclosure.
PRIVACY.S6_BODY: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us through our support channels.
PRIVACY.S7_BODY: For any questions about this privacy policy, please contact the Erwaa Institute support team via the email or WhatsApp number listed on the Contact Us page.
PRIVACY.S8_BODY: Erwaa Higher Institute for Training owns, operates, and manages this online platform, and is responsible for the technical aspects of managing the personal data described in this policy.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms & Conditions

TERMS.S2_BODY: Erwaa Higher Institute for Training provides accredited diploma programs and vocational and developmental training courses, delivered on-site and online, licensed by the Technical and Vocational Training Corporation, through a select group of qualified trainers.
TERMS.S3_BODY: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential. Use of the platform for any unlawful purpose or in violation of applicable regulations is strictly prohibited.
TERMS.S4_BODY: All platform content including text, logos, and designs are the exclusive property of Erwaa Higher Institute for Training and are protected under applicable intellectual property laws.
TERMS.S5_BODY: Erwaa Higher Institute for Training shall not be liable for indirect damages arising from the use of, or inability to access, the platform, to the extent permitted by law.
TERMS.S6_BODY: These Terms are governed by the applicable laws and regulations of Saudi Arabia, including regulations related to personal data protection and e-commerce.
TERMS.S7_BODY: Erwaa Higher Institute for Training reserves the right to update these Terms at any time with appropriate notice. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
TERMS.S8_BODY: Erwaa Higher Institute for Training is the owner and operator of this online platform, and is responsible for the technical aspects of the platform and application described in these Terms.

OWNERSHIP.TITLE: Platform & Brand Ownership
OWNERSHIP.S1_BODY: Erwaa Higher Institute for Training is the official owner of this online platform (the website and, when available, the application), and handles its design, development, and technical operation.
OWNERSHIP.S2_BODY: "Erwaa Higher Institute for Training" is the trade name under which all programs, diplomas, and training courses on this platform are offered.
OWNERSHIP.S3_BODY: The brand, logo, and training content of Erwaa Higher Institute for Training are the property of the Institute, and are protected under applicable intellectual property regulations in Saudi Arabia.

FAQ.TITLE: Everything you need. Explained simply
FAQ.DESCRIPTIPN: Everything you need to know about Nabd Plus, from medical services and emergencies to subscriptions and corporate solutions — all in one clear and easy-to-access place.

FAQ1.QUESTION: What is Nabd Plus?
FAQ1.ANSWER: Nabd Plus is an integrated health platform that connects individuals, companies, and medical service providers in one place, making it easier to access health services, emergencies, and medical products with ease and reliability.

FAQ2.QUESTION: How can I book a medical service?
FAQ2.ANSWER: You can create an account, browse available medical services, and choose the appointment or service provider that suits you easily through the platform.

FAQ3.QUESTION: Are all service providers accredited?
FAQ3.ANSWER: Yes, all medical service providers on Nabd Plus undergo a verification and accreditation process to ensure the quality and reliability of the services provided.

FAQ4.QUESTION: How does the emergency service work?
FAQ4.ANSWER: When you request help, the system identifies the nearest available service provider with the ability to track the arrival in real-time.

FAQ5.QUESTION: Can companies subscribe to Nabd Plus?
FAQ5.ANSWER: Yes, Nabd Plus offers flexible subscription packages for companies to help them manage employee healthcare easily and efficiently.

FAQ6.QUESTION: What types of products are available on the platform?
FAQ6.ANSWER: The platform offers a diverse range of health and medical products such as medical devices, health supplies, and home care products from trusted sellers.

FAQ7.QUESTION: Does Nabd Plus support the English language?
FAQ7.ANSWER: Yes, the platform supports both Arabic and English to provide a user experience suitable for all users.

FAQ8.QUESTION: How can I contact support?
FAQ8.ANSWER: You can contact the support team directly through the platform or via the contact page to get help and answers to your questions.

FAQ.Q1: How long does the ambulance take to arrive?
FAQ.A1: In urban areas the ambulance arrives in under 8 minutes on average. In more remote areas it may take up to 15 minutes depending on location.
FAQ.Q2: Can I schedule a medical transport in advance?
FAQ.A2: Yes, the scheduled medical transport service allows you to book at least 24 hours in advance.
FAQ.Q3: Are the ambulances equipped for all conditions?
FAQ.A3: Yes, every ambulance is equipped with ventilators, cardiac monitors, CPR equipment, and a full medication stock.
FAQ.Q4: Is the service available in my city?
FAQ.A4: We cover more than 100 cities and towns. You can check coverage in the app by entering your location.
FAQ.Q5: What happens if no vehicle is nearby?
FAQ.A5: Our system immediately expands the search radius and notifies you of the earliest available time, while providing emergency contact alternatives.

TESTIMONIALS.ITEM1_QUOTE:
Peace be upon you.

To start, my college's curriculum felt average — broad but plain — while the institute's curriculum was far more useful and comprehensive, even though a few areas could use more depth. And of course, a curriculum without good teaching isn't truly useful to a trainee.

At the institute, theory lessons were taught in a focused way that actually helped understanding, while at college the theory was sometimes just reading the syllabus or memorizing it.

As for practical teaching, my college barely focused on it — most students just memorized code for exams. The institute, on the other hand, focused heavily and well on the practical side, with varied examples, because computer subjects need hands-on practice to really sink in, not just theory.

The way we were treated was also very different — the director, staff, and trainers at the institute treated us wonderfully, cooperative and responsive to our requests. At college, dealing with professors was hard for me, and I honestly didn't feel enough attention was given to students' needs.

At the institute, I never felt pressured or stressed, whether during exams or throughout the program. The exam questions were clear and understanding-based, while at college the questions were often harder despite explanations not always being clear.

One thing the institute cared about that college didn't do the same way was giving trainees breaks during long sessions — excellent, since trainees need time to absorb the material.

After finishing two years at the institute, we came out with a lot of knowledge and several programming languages — enough to help you find your direction and understand your interests. Compare that to my four years earning a Computer Science bachelor's, where the practical knowledge I gained was far less.
TESTIMONIALS.ITEM2_QUOTE:
Peace be upon you.

I'm Sheikha Tamim Al-Mubarak Al-Dosari, and I'd like to introduce myself and share my experience studying the diploma.

I benefited a great deal during my studies, especially learning programming, and the specialization's coverage of general computer subjects. This field taught me a lot — including focus and how to use computer software — and broadened my thinking.

I hope this specialization continues so our daughters can benefit from it too, since it keeps pace with the times ahead. Credit goes to God, then to the trainers who taught us and made the material easy and smooth to learn.

I hope specialized programming courses are held for graduates, to keep empowering them and developing their skills.

Thank you to Erwaa Institute's management and everyone supporting it for their efforts and care.
TESTIMONIALS.ITEM3_QUOTE:
As a graduate of the Computer Software Diploma at Erwaa Institute, my experience was extremely useful and powerful. The opportunity I had over these two years was a distinctive one — I succeeded in taking a path different from my university major.

The courses were excellent and smooth thanks to the trainers' cooperation with us — they helped and stood by us through every difficulty. I was especially happy that our trainers were from the Al-Aflaj region, a strong sign that the region produces highly capable graduates, which made me proud to have them as role models.

I want to reassure trainees in upcoming cohorts not to worry about studying at the institute — it's a capable, cooperative institution, the trainers are skilled and competent, and the institute's approach is flexible and excellent. You can submit suggestions and you'll find them warmly welcomed.

All thanks to Erwaa Institute, our dear supervisor, and the wonderful trainers for their effort and dedication.
TESTIMONIALS.ITEM4_QUOTE:
My experience with the Computer Software Diploma was very positive overall. I learned a lot and gained the skills and experience needed to succeed in this field and enter the world of programming.

It's also an excellent investment in my professional future, giving me strong technical skills and important personal skills.

I recommend everyone interested in programming to get the Computer Software Diploma — it's a solid foundation for building a successful career in this promising field.

The Computer Software Diploma is truly wonderful — honestly, in my first year earning a Computer Science bachelor's, I didn't learn nearly as much as I did from this diploma.

Now I work on a website and understand every line in it, thanks to what I learned during the diploma.

And of course, I can't forget that the trainers are the reason I understood the material and had it delivered so well — they were understanding whenever we struggled with something, repeating and re-explaining it as many times as needed.

I hope with all my heart, just as I benefited from studying at Erwaa Higher Institute, that more cohorts get to benefit from this specialization — it's a wonderful field with a real future, God willing.

All the staff at Erwaa carry out their work in the best way, from explaining material to delivering it clearly — reason enough for me to say: I hope there will be more cohorts.

Thank you all for your efforts.
TESTIMONIALS.ITEM5_QUOTE:
Learning and joining Erwaa Higher Institute for Training was far better than [college] — truly an enriching experience in every sense of the word.

The institute stands out for focusing on foundations first, then real specialization — not just in name. The curriculum is very suitable and useful, and I benefited greatly from getting clear answers to my questions about the programming field in general.

The Computer Software specialization is one of the fields that matter for Vision 2030, and it deserves to be discovered and given its due so everyone can benefit.

I'm very grateful for joining this specialization, which let me discover so much more.
